display: Pi Derivations — every route, labelled by what of the circle it holds
descriptive: Computes π by each route the project meets without reading math.pi, and labels each route by circle_in: none, orbit, constructed, dual, path, library or identity. cos_zero (twice the first positive zero of the cosine power series) is the emergent π: it defines the circle's period before any circle is drawn.
